title: First Call
summary: A stranger called Vesper wants to know if you can drive. And walk. And duck.

objectives.text: Get in the car in the yard

onStart.text: Walk with the left stick. Tap ENTER beside a car to get in.
onStart.desktop: Walk with WASD. Press E beside a car to get in.

onStart.text: Push the stick the way you want to go. HANDBRAKE swings you round corners.
onStart.desktop: W/S to drive, A/D to steer, Space for the handbrake.

objectives.text: Get out and walk to the park

onStart.text: Slow down, then tap EXIT to get out.
onStart.desktop: Slow down, then press E to get out.

onStart.text: Tap DODGE to roll. A roll makes you hard to hit.
onStart.desktop: Press Shift to roll. A roll makes you hard to hit.

onStart.text: Turn to face them and tap FIRE. Roll when they shoot.
onStart.desktop: Face them and click (or press F) to fire. Roll when they shoot.

onStart.text: HEAT: patrols are looking for you. Break their line of sight until the chevron fades.

objectives.text: Take any car to Vesper's garage

onStart.text: Any car will do. Tap STEAL beside one in traffic to take it.
onStart.desktop: Any car will do. Press E beside one in traffic to take it.
